info.name: Stellar Alerts API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Stellar Alerts Fastify API.

## Quick start

1. Set `{{baseUrl}}` (default `http://localhost:3001`).
2. Run **Authentication → Magic Link → Verify Magic Link** (or **SEP-10 → Verify SEP-10 Challenge**). Its test script stores the access token in `{{jwtToken}}`.
3. Every protected request inherits/sends `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

## What is covered

All routes registered by `apps/api/src/app.ts`: health, SSE, auth (magic link, DID, Telegram, SEP-10, refresh/logout, MFA), wallets and ingestion cursor status, payments, webhooks, alert rules, notification preferences and Telegram Mini App, dead letters and sandbox replays, exports, simulations, account lifecycle, GraphQL, Slack, Discord, and DLQ administration.

## Variables

`{{jwtToken}}` is the only credential you normally need to set by hand. IDs (`{{walletId}}`, `{{webhookId}}`, `{{alertRuleId}}`, `{{exportId}}`, `{{simulationId}}`, `{{deadLetterId}}`) are saved automatically by create/list requests when the API returns them.

Provider callbacks need real signatures: Slack (`X-Slack-Signature`), Discord (`X-Signature-Ed25519`), and the Telegram Mini App (`X-Telegram-Init-Data`). Those headers intentionally use empty placeholders.

## Notes

- Mutation requests that support idempotency send an `Idempotency-Key` of `{{$guid}}`.
- `GET /events` is an open SSE stream and will stay pending in Postman.
- `GET /exports/:id/download` is authorized by its signed query pair, not a bearer token.

item.name: Health & Realtime
item.description: Liveness, deep dependency health, and the server-sent events stream. These endpoints are public.

request.description:
Liveness probe. Returns `{ "status": "ok" }` when the Fastify process is accepting requests.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Checks PostgreSQL, Redis (BullMQ client), and the Soroban/Horizon RPC.

Returns **200** when every dependency is `ok` and **503** with `status: "degraded"` when any check fails, so the response body is still inspectable during an incident.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Prometheus text exposition (queue depth, worker latency, active workers, process uptime, heap usage, and webhook dispatch histograms). Public endpoint used by monitoring scrapers.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Server-Sent Events stream of payment events (`event: connected` immediately, then `event: payment` frames).

The connection is held open until the client disconnects, so Postman may show the request as pending — use the Postman console or a terminal `curl -N` to watch frames.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Magic-link, DID, Telegram, SEP-10, rotating sessions, and MFA. The verify endpoints save the returned access token into `{{jwtToken}}` via their test scripts.

request.description:
Sends (or, in non-production, logs) a one-time magic-link token.

In development the response also includes the raw `token`; the test script stores it in `{{magicToken}}`.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

query.description: Magic-link token from the API response (development) or from the delivered email.

request.description:
Exchanges a magic-link token for a session. Saves `{{jwtToken}}` and `{{refreshToken}}` for later requests.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Starts wallet-based authentication by returning a challenge for a `did:pkh:stellar` identifier. The challenge expires after `DID_CHALLENGE_TTL_SECONDS`.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Verifies the wallet signature over the challenge and issues a session. Saves `{{jwtToken}}` when the response contains a token.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Authenticates a Telegram Mini App user by validating the signed `initData` string (HMAC-SHA256 against `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`). The payload must contain a `hash=` field.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Returns a SEP-0010 challenge transaction envelope (`transaction` base64 XDR) plus the network passphrase. The test script stores the envelope in `{{sep10Transaction}}`.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Verifies the client-signed challenge envelope, upserts the user/wallet, and returns session tokens. Saves `{{jwtToken}}` and `{{refreshToken}}`.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Rotates a refresh token and returns a new access token. Refresh tokens are single-use; reuse revokes the session family. Saves the new tokens into collection variables.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Returns the authenticated user profile.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Revokes the current token's session family. Leave `familyId` empty to revoke the family carried by the access token, or provide a family id to revoke another session.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Revokes the current session and blocklists its JWT id. Clear or replace `{{jwtToken}}` afterwards.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Generates a TOTP secret and QR code for the authenticated user. MFA is not active until `/auth/mfa/enable` succeeds.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Enables MFA after verifying a 6-digit TOTP token from the authenticator app. Returns one-time recovery codes.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Disables MFA. Requires a valid current TOTP token, not a recovery code.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Returns whether MFA is enabled plus the total and remaining recovery-code counts.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Generates a fresh set of one-time recovery codes, invalidating the previous set. Store them securely; they are shown only once.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Returns the total and remaining recovery-code counts without exposing the codes.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Lost-device recovery: consumes a one-time recovery code and issues a new session for the email. Rate limited and replay protected.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

item.name: Wallets & Ingestion
item.description: Wallet registration, listing, ingestion cursor status, and deletion. All routes require a bearer token; mutations also accept `Idempotency-Key`.

request.description:
Registers a Stellar wallet for ingestion. The public key must be a valid Ed25519 StrKey (G...) with a correct checksum. Saves the created id to `{{walletId}}` and the address to `{{stellarPublicKey}}`.

Supports an optional `Idempotency-Key` header (1–255 chars, alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen).

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Lists the authenticated user's wallets with cursor pagination. The test script stores the first wallet id in `{{walletId}}`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Cursor status for a wallet: the last time the ingestion worker processed it and whether it is actively tracked. Use the id returned by **Add Wallet** or **List Wallets**.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Deletes a tracked wallet and stops ingestion for it. Wallet-scoped alert rules and payments are removed by the cascade defined in the Prisma schema.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Payment history, summaries, and Soroban fee estimation. All routes require a bearer token.

query.description: Optional wallet filter; omit to list across all wallets.
Inclusive lower bound (ISO date or date-time).
Inclusive upper bound (ISO date or date-time).

request.description:
Returns the authenticated user's payments with cursor pagination and optional filters. The response is `{ success, payments, pagination }`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

query.description: Optional wallet filter; omit for the aggregate across wallets.
Fiat currency used for conversions (defaults to the API configuration).

request.description:
Returns aggregate payment statistics (totals, per-asset breakdown, conversion currency).

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Simulates a Soroban transaction envelope and returns the inclusion fee, resource/rent fee, total fee in stroops and XLM, ledger footprints, and CPU/memory estimates.

Returns **422** when the simulation fails; `details` explains why.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

item.name: Webhooks
item.description: Outbound webhook management, test delivery, and delivery logs. All routes require a bearer token; POST/DELETE accept `Idempotency-Key`.

request.description:
Registers an HTTPS receiver for payment events. The receiver URL must be a valid URL (max 2048 chars). `payloadTemplate` is optional Handlebars JSON (max 16 KB) rendered with `{ event, timestamp, data: { paymentId, txHash, amount, asset, assetIssuer, fromAddress, receivedAt } }`. Saves the created id to `{{webhookId}}`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Lists the authenticated user's webhook subscriptions. The test script stores the first id in `{{webhookId}}`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Sends a synthetic delivery to the webhook receiver and returns the delivery result. This is intentionally not idempotency-cached because the whole point is to trigger a new send.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Returns delivery attempts for one webhook (status code, response body, error) with cursor pagination.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Removes a webhook subscription and its delivery logs.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

item.name: Alert Rules
item.description: Alert rule CRUD, activation toggling, and legacy filter migration. All routes require a bearer token.

request.description:
Creates a rule that matches incoming payments. All body fields are optional except the implied owner from the bearer token:

- `walletId` — scope to one wallet; omit for all wallets
- `assets` — asset codes; empty means any asset
- `minAmount` / `maxAmount` — decimal strings
- `channels` — e.g. `telegram`, `email`, `discord`, `slack`, `whatsapp`, `push`
- `conditions` — optional `{ operator: "AND" | "OR", rules: [...] }` filter group

Saves the created rule id to `{{alertRuleId}}`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Lists the authenticated user's alert rules. The test script stores the first id in `{{alertRuleId}}`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Returns one alert rule owned by the authenticated user.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Updates an alert rule. Include `expectedVersion` for optimistic concurrency; a mismatch returns **409** `CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Enables or disables an alert rule without editing the rest of it.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Converts legacy notification `filterRules` into an AlertRule. Returns `migrated: false` when there is nothing to migrate.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Permanently deletes an alert rule.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Notification preferences, freelancer channel setup, Telegram account linking, test pings, and the Telegram Mini App. Mini App routes authenticate with `X-Telegram-Init-Data`, not a bearer token.

request.description:
Updates notification routing. `mfaToken` (6-digit TOTP) is required only when the user has MFA enabled. WhatsApp numbers must be E.164; Discord/Slack URLs must match their provider hostnames.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

body.raw:
{
  "telegramEnabled": true,
  "emailEnabled": true,
  "whatsappEnabled": false,
  "whatsappNumber": "+14155551234",
  "discordEnabled": true,
  "discordWebhookUrl": "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/123456789012345678/example-token",
  "slackEnabled": false,
  "pushEnabled": false,
  "enabledChannels": [
    "telegram",
    "email",
    "discord"
  ],
  "assetFilters": [
    "XLM",
    "USDC"
  ],
  "minAmount": 10,
  "receiptPreference": "instant",
  "language": "EN",
  "mfaToken": ""
}

request.description:
Returns the authenticated user's notification preferences, or an empty object if none have been saved.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Freelancer-focused alias for updating channel setup. Returns the persisted preferences after the write.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Returns the same preference payload as `GET /notifications/preferences`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Creates a single-use Telegram linking code (15-minute TTL), a `t.me` deep link, and a QR code. Saves the code to `{{telegramSyncCode}}`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Called by the Telegram bot to consume the sync code and link the chat to the user. The code expires after 15 minutes and cannot be reused.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Polls whether a sync code has been confirmed and by which chat. The status route lets the web UI finish linking without polling the bot.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Removes the Telegram chat binding and disables Telegram notifications for the authenticated user.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Sends a one-off test notification on a configured channel (`telegram` or `push`) so the onboarding wizard can verify the link before activation.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Bootstrap payload for the in-bot Mini App: notification routes, per-asset thresholds, and the live alert feed.

Authenticated by the signed `initData` in the `X-Telegram-Init-Data` header — there is no bearer token on this route.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Returns only the live alert feed for the Telegram user. Requires `X-Telegram-Init-Data`.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Turns one notification route on or off from the Mini App. Valid routes: `telegram`, `email`, `whatsapp`, `discord`, `slack`, `push`. Requires `X-Telegram-Init-Data`.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Sets a per-asset minimum amount for Mini App alerts. Send `minAmount: null` to clear the threshold. Requires `X-Telegram-Init-Data`.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

item.name: Dead Letters
item.description: Dead-letter queue inspection, replay, suppression, and the webhook sandbox replay inspector. All routes require a bearer token; mutations accept `Idempotency-Key`.

query.description: Only include entries newer than this many days (1–365).

request.description:
Lists terminal delivery failures for the authenticated user. The test script stores the first id in `{{deadLetterId}}`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Returns one dead letter with the original payload, failure class, and retry history.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Re-enqueues the original delivery. Suppressed dead letters cannot be replayed (409).

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Marks a dead letter as suppressed so it is excluded from retries. The optional note is stored for audit.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Replays the dead letter against the in-process mock receiver with a caller-chosen response (status 100–599, body up to 64 KB, up to 50 headers). Useful for exercising success and provider-error paths. Saves the inspection id to `{{sandboxReplayId}}`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Lists recorded sandbox/webhook-ping inspections for the authenticated user. The test script stores the first id in `{{sandboxReplayId}}`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Returns one sandbox inspection: request envelope/headers/body, mock response, timing, and verdict.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

item.name: Exports
item.description: Asynchronous ledger/tax export jobs. CRUD routes require a bearer token; the download link is authorized by its signed `expires`/`sig` query pair.

request.description:
Queues an export job. `type` is one of `ledger_csv`, `ledger_pdf`, `tax_csv`; `format` (`cointracker`, `koinly`, `irs8949`) applies to `tax_csv`. Returns **202** with a `Location` header and saves the job id to `{{exportId}}`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Lists export jobs newest first. The test script stores the first id in `{{exportId}}`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Returns one export job. A completed, unexpired job includes a freshly signed `download.url`; the test script splits its `expires` and `sig` parameters into `{{exportExpires}}` and `{{exportSig}}` for the download request.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

query.description: Expiry timestamp from the signed download URL.
HMAC signature from the signed download URL.

request.description:
Streams the generated file. The signed `expires`/`sig` pair is the credential, so this route deliberately does not use a bearer token. Unknown jobs and bad signatures both return 403.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

item.name: Simulations
item.description: Pre-execution transaction risk analysis. All routes require a bearer token.

request.description:
Analyzes up to 1000 operations and returns a persisted risk assessment (SAFE/LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL) with indicators. Amounts are decimal strings. Rate limited to 20 requests per minute per client. Saves the assessment id to `{{simulationId}}`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

query.description: Filter by risk band: SAFE, LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, CRITICAL.

request.description:
Lists the authenticated user's simulation history. The test script stores the first id in `{{simulationId}}`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Returns one persisted assessment. Responses are sent with `Cache-Control: no-store` because they encode security decisions.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

item.name: Account
item.description: Data export and irreversible account deletion for the authenticated user.

query.description: Send `csv` for a downloadable payment ledger; omit for the JSON payload.

request.description:
Returns all data held about the authenticated user as JSON, including a `paymentsCsv` field. Add `?format=csv` for a `text/csv` attachment.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

**Irreversible.** Permanently deletes the user and cascades wallets, payments, webhooks, alert rules, preferences, and other owned rows. Returns a deletion summary so callers can verify what was removed. Clear local session storage afterwards.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

item.name: Integrations
item.description: GraphQL and provider callback endpoints. These routes do not use bearer auth; Discord and Slack verify provider signatures instead.

request.description:
Apollo GraphQL endpoint (GET and POST are both mounted). The schema exposes `health` plus payment/Soroban/metrics subscriptions. This route has no bearer auth.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

GET form of the GraphQL endpoint, useful for quick health checks and browser testing.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

Slack slash-command callback. Slack signs the raw urlencoded body; the API verifies `X-Slack-Signature` against `X-Slack-Request-Timestamp`, so placeholders must be replaced with a real signature inside Slack's 5-minute replay window.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

urlencoded.description: Channel where the command was invoked.

request.description:
Discord interactions webhook. `type: 1` is an endpoint-verification PING without a real Ed25519 signature. Discord signs the raw body with `X-Signature-Ed25519` and `X-Signature-Timestamp`; the API rejects invalid signatures with 401.

Public endpoint — no bearer token required.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Dead-letter queue administration. These routes are authenticated like user routes; restrict access at the gateway in production.

request.description:
Inspects dead-letter entries with failure details and payload metadata. Use `limit`/`offset` for paging.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Re-enqueues the selected dead-letter ids, or every entry matching `filter` when `ids` is omitted. Set `force` to replay even when a circuit breaker is open.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.

Permanently removes dead-letter entries older than `olderThanDays` (or `olderThanDate`) matching the optional status/channel filters.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer {{jwtToken}}`.
